messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick update — finished a KV-only mixed-precision shadow run comparing FP8-KV vs INT8-KV on the 30B bring-up. Summary first: INT8-KV saves more memory but has a small tail-latency hit; FP8-KV keeps p50 tight and slightly better end-to-end quality on some prompt families.

AJ Pratt: nice. can you drop the exact numbers?

Maria Gomez: sure. Setup: model=open-30b-v1 (no structural changes), sequence=2048, batch=1 steady state, 2k warmup requests, offline offline-run harness. Kernel: optimized KV path with explicit dequant for INT8.

Maria Gomez: Results (median across 10 seeds):
- Baseline FP32-KV: mem=100% (baseline), p50=28ms, p95=120ms, quality=100% (eval baseline)
- FP8-KV: mem ~= 68% (-32%), p50=30ms (+2ms), p95=125ms (+5ms), quality ~= 99.2% (delta -0.8%)
- INT8-KV: mem ~= 54% (-46%), p50=34ms (+6ms), p95=150ms (+30ms), quality ~= 98.9% (delta -1.1%)

Samir Patel: interesting p95 jump on INT8. is that cold-start or steady-state tail?

Maria Gomez: mostly steady-state. hypothesis: explicit dequant + extra memcpy on the hot path under certain receptive-length patterns causes occasional stalls. We saw correlation with KV-eviction activity when prefix reuse drops.

AJ Pratt: did you try hybrid FP8-KV for head layers + INT8 for rest?

Maria Gomez: yes — quick hybrid run: FP8 on first 8 layers + INT8 on rest -> mem 60% (-40%), p50=31ms, p95=132ms, quality 99.1%. So hybrid recovers some tail.

Lena (ops-bot): @Maria Gomez please paste the exact run IDs so ops can trace infra logs. :eyes:

Maria Gomez: run IDs: bench-171450-A (FP8), bench-171450-B (INT8), bench-171450-C (hybrid). Command used: `./bench_runner --model open-30b-v1 --kv-quant {FP8|INT8|HYBRID} --seq 2048 --batch 1 --warmup 2000`

Samir Patel: any accuracy regressions on instruction-following evals?

Maria Gomez: small regressions concentrated on long-coherent tasks (story continuation, doc summarization). Perplexity delta mirrors eval: INT8 worse by ~1.2% on long-context metrics, FP8 ~0.7%. Short Q/A unaffected.

AJ Pratt: can we mitigate INT8 p95 without sacrificing memory? e.g., prefetching dequant or keep hot-slices in FP16 cache?

Maria Gomez: experimented with hot-slice caching (keep top-k recent KV blocks in FP16) — reduced INT8 p95 from 150ms -> 118ms but memory bumped from 54% -> 62%. Tradeoff looks promising for latency-sensitive tiers.

benchbot: automated regression check: quality deltas within current rollout guardrails for FP8 and hybrid, INT8 flagged for further review (p95 threshold).

AJ Pratt: OK. proposal: ship FP8-KV for dedicated and hosted default, keep INT8-KV as opt-in for aggressive mem-constrained configs, and add hot-slice cache option with heuristic `kv_hot_cache_ratio=0.08`.

Maria Gomez: agree. I'll open a PR with the config knobs, the run logs, and a short ops playbook for the hot-slice cache. leaving notes in the bench runs folder.

Samir Patel: thanks — can you also add the microprofiler flame for the INT8 path? that will help kernel folks.

Maria Gomez: will attach profiler snapshots to bench-171450-B. Good call.

Lena (ops-bot): noted. created ticket #INF-2437 to follow up on INT8 tail investigation.

AJ Pratt: :thumbsup: moving to docs review after PR.

Maria Gomez: thanks all. low-churn thread, ping if you want raw traces.
